site_name: Churchill War Rooms At Clive Steps
decision_conditions: LB Int works to match existing
LBC works in accord with apprvd plans
description:
Works to the Cafe at Imperial War Museum, Churchill War Rooms, London.

Works Include:

Minor Demolitions: 
Existing Vinyl Flooring to be removed
Existing Art work to be removed from walls
Existing Front Counter to be removed 
Existing Shelving to be removed
Existing Linear light to be removed 

Proposed works:
New Vinyl flooring to be laid over new screed.
New artwork to be fixed to existing walls, new fixings to be fixed through existing holes and within mortar joint.
New Front to existing location, New back counter with Gantry. 
New paint to walls and ceiling.
Existing doors to be sanded and painted, ironmongery to be retained and reused.
2no. new way finding signage and 1no. menu board. New fixings to be fixed through mortar joint.
